blocks.html: Robinsons Malls supports local farmers as the mall chain continues to host several agricultural fairs where fresh produce such as vegetables, fruits, and locally produced food items are showcased.
In partnership with the Department of Agriculture Western Visayas, ‘Kadiwa ni Ani at Kita was staged at the event area of Robinson Place Iloilo.
Thirteen (13) exhibitors are featured who are members of farmers’ cooperatives and associations from the different provinces of the region.

Through this five-day event, farmers found an avenue to sell and encourage the public to consume indigenous food resources and products that are locally grown to help farmers who are struggling due to the pandemic.

There were also other exciting activities apart from the exhibit such as a culinary show on how to cook Ilonggo recipes using only indigenous ingredients, food presentation tips, health and wellness seminar, and series of lectures on the topic of coffee and cacao production.
